In our exhibit you'll find original art, novels, short stories and more set on these fantastic celestial bodies. This exhibit can be viewed during the Merril Collection's regular hours. events.description: Throughout the month of July, the works of artist Asefeh Katoozian are on display at Morningside branch. events.description: Drop by Fort York Library to find local duck species hidden around the branch and win a special 3D printed prize made in Fort York's own Digital Innovation Hub! This month's scavenger hunt features illustrations of local Toronto duck species from the Special Collections in the Arts at the Toronto Reference Library, many of which can be spotted in their full feathered glory on Toronto's waterfront.

events.description: Join us as we make kumihimo friendship bracelets! Kumihimo translates literally to "gathered threads" and is a traditional Japanese braiding technique and artform with a rich history. Ages 6+. Drop-in. Large Groups and camps must call ahead to attend.
